item.title: Kioti Tractor rolls out Kioti Connect 2.0
item.description: Among other features, Kioti Connect 2.0 includes an intelligent assistant that translates technical machine data and alerts into guidance.

item.title: Lawn & Landscape announces keynote for Technology Conference
item.description: Theresa Payton, the CEO of Fortalice Solutions, will tell attendees about artificial intelligence and the future of AI in landscaping.

item.title: Schill Grounds Management acquires Begonia Brothers Services, Atlas Outdoor
item.description: These are Schill’s first acquisitions in Michigan.

item.title: Volvo CE makes Unicontrol's 3D machine control tech available on excavators
item.description: The Unicontrol3D system will be fully integrated with Volvo Active Control, providing one interface with one set of hardware.

item.title: Mammotion robotic lawn mowers to hit shelves at Walmart, Home Depot and Lowe’s
item.description: Building on its existing Walmart online e-commerce partnership, Mammotion products are now available in more than 700 Walmart stores across North America.

item.title: Diamond Landscaping hires Anson Martin as CEO
item.description: Most recently, Martin served six years as CEO and board president of Burroughs.

item.title: Reinders to host 27th biennial Turf Conference in March
item.description: The event will be held March 11-12 at the Waukesha Expo Center in suburban Milwaukee.

item.title: MNLGA, Schaefer Center for Public Policy evaluate Maryland's landscaping business
item.description: The 2024 Statistical Profile and Economic Survey of the Maryland Horticulture Industry provides a detailed look at sales trends, workforce conditions and more.

item.title: Toro to give away Dingo TX 450 at American Rental Association Show
item.description: Attendees can visit the Toro booth (4626) at the ARA Show.

item.title: Housecall Pro releases new integration with Yelp
